witness_description: In the ambient group S_3 on {0,1,2}, take H_1=S_3 and H_2=N_2={id,(0 1)}.
refutation_explanation: N_2 is normal in H_2 because N_2=H_2. But H_1∩N_2=N_2 is not normal in H_1: conjugation of (0 1) by (1 2) gives (0 2), which is not in N_2.
search_space: All 216 ordered triples (H_1,H_2,N_2) of the six subgroups of S_3, retaining those with N_2 normal in H_2 and testing whether H_1∩N_2 is normal in H_1.
